reasons: Claimed status is compliant, and the cited paragraphs support it: Section 17(b) (p0118) gives Sparkling a 90-day convenience termination right with only cease-use and certification/return obligations, no termination fee or accelerated remaining contract value.

p0084 limits Customer payment obligations to fees 'as set out in the Fee Schedule' with no stipulated sum, penalty or interest mechanic; p0128 shows termination amounts flowing to the Customer (fee refund plus perpetual license on Vendor default), consistent with the rule's note that LDs payable by Vendor to Customer are compliant.
No redline or comment was proposed, which is the expected output for a compliant finding; rendered redline is identical to the originals and no deterministic checks failed.

Rationale addresses the only near-miss references (the 'penalties' term appears inside Garman's indemnity of Sparkling, and the non-solicit carries no liquidated fee), so the preferred position ('no liquidated damages or penalties payable by Customer') is met without an edit.
